A cutting needs a node, a leaf, and patience. Cut just below a node,
strip the lower leaves, and stand the cutting in water or damp perlite
with the node submerged.

Roots appear as white nubs; move to soil when they reach a couple of
centimetres, not before — moving early is the most common loss.
Humidity helps, so a clear bag over the pot for the first fortnight
does more than misting ever does.
